# Crams Creative

> Freelance web developer & designer based in the Philippines, building fast, accessible, high-converting websites, web apps, and brand experiences for businesses. Fixed-price quotes, no upsell.

## Pages
- [Work](https://www.cramscreative.com/#work): Live website projects with case studies (e-commerce, corporate, restaurant, sports club, SaaS).
- [Apps](https://www.cramscreative.com/#apps): Custom business software with demo videos (ClinicOS, PayrollOS, InventoryOS, Invoicer, POS).
- [Services](https://www.cramscreative.com/#services): Websites, web apps & systems, branding, UI/UX, SEO, maintenance, motion & video ([#motion](https://www.cramscreative.com/#motion)).
- [Process](https://www.cramscreative.com/#process): Five steps from discovery to launch and scale.
- [Pricing](https://www.cramscreative.com/#pricing): Landing pages from $59, business websites from $299, custom quotes for apps and e-commerce.
- [About](https://www.cramscreative.com/#about): Marc Patrick Orcullo, founder; tech stack in [#skills](https://www.cramscreative.com/#skills) (React, Next.js, Supabase, Tailwind, Framer Motion, Three.js).
- [Contact](https://www.cramscreative.com/#contact): Free, fixed-price quote within 24 hours; [FAQ](https://www.cramscreative.com/#faq).
